Mr. Sanjay Banga is the Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director of Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited and currently holds the position of President – Renewables of The Tata Power Company Limited (“Tata Power”).
Mr. Banga previously served as President of the Transmission and Distribution businesses.

Mr. Banga also served as the Chief Executive Officer of Tata Power Delhi Distribution Limited (TPDDL), a notable Public-Private Partnership (JV) between Tata Power and the Government of the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

Mr. Banga began his career as an Engineer Trainee at National Thermal Power Corporation Limited (NTPC), where he was involved in the operation and commissioning of super thermal power projects from 1989 to 1995.

Before joining TPDDL in 2003, he worked with Reliance Energy (formerly BSES Limited) from 1996 to 2003, with responsibilities covering operations, maintenance, planning, design and project engineering for thermal power projects.
Mr. Banga is an alumnus of the National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra, and holds a Master of Business Administration degree from the Faculty of Management Studies, University of Delhi.
